# Production XHS fixtures

Synthetic JSON-compatible page hydration. Shapes follow MediaFlow's observed
`noteData.data.noteData`, `note.noteDetailMap.*.note`, `imageList` and
`video.media.stream.*.masterUrl` research evidence. IDs identify fixed public
sample roles; URLs, authors and titles are synthetic, with no credentials or
signed media URL. These fixtures verify internal logic, never real platform PASS.
No third-party source code copied. Resource order is the JSON array order.
